svg.desc: Three ads with bids and predicted click-through rates, ranked by eCPM equals pCTR times bid times 1000: A at 60, B at 48, C at 40 dollars. A wins and pays per click the runner-up's eCPM divided by its own pCTR times 1000, 48 over 30 equals 1.60 dollars, below its 2 dollar bid.
